```{r}
library(dplyr)     # <- spelling was wrong (dplry ❌)
library(tidyr)
library(qqman)


jostD_result <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat_jostD/ethopia_by_site_JostD_new.csv.gz")

annotating_file <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.ann.wide.tsv",sep="\t")

print(colnames(jostD_result))
print(colnames(annotating_file))
merging_jostD_ann <- jostD_result %>%
    left_join(annotating_file,by=c("POS"="pos")) 
#write.csv(merging_jostD_ann,"/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat_jostD/ethopia_by_site_JostD_new_annotate.csv")


merging_jostD_ann$CHROM <- gsub("Pf3D7_0?(\\d+)_v3", "\\1", merging_jostD_ann$CHROM)
merging_jostD_ann$CHROM <- as.numeric(merging_jostD_ann$CHROM)
# Rename columns to match qqman format
colnames(merging_jostD_ann)[colnames(merging_jostD_ann) == "CHROM"] <- "CHR"
colnames(merging_jostD_ann)[colnames(merging_jostD_ann) == "POS"]   <- "BP"
colnames(merging_jostD_ann)[colnames(merging_jostD_ann) == "JostD"]      <- "P"
#colnames(merging_jostD_ann)[colnames(merging_jostD_ann) == "Gene_name"]     <- "SNP"

class(merging_jostD_ann$JostD)
```

```{r}
#library(qqman, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)
preparing_jostD1 <- jostD_result %>%
  mutate(merge_pop = paste0(pop1, "vs", pop2)) 
for (i in unique(preparing_jostD1$merge_pop)){
  print(i)
  #print(nrow(filter(preparing_jostD, merge_pop == i)))
  preparing_jostD <- preparing_jostD1 %>%
    filter(merge_pop == i) %>%
    filter(JostD > 0.1) %>% 
    mutate(SNP = paste("SNP", row_number()))


  
preparing_jostD$CHROM <- gsub("Pf3D7_0?(\\d+)_v3", "\\1", preparing_jostD$CHROM)
preparing_jostD$CHROM <- as.numeric(preparing_jostD$CHROM)
# Rename columns to match qqman format
colnames(preparing_jostD)[colnames(preparing_jostD) == "CHROM"] <- "CHR"
colnames(preparing_jostD)[colnames(preparing_jostD) == "POS"]   <- "BP"
colnames(preparing_jostD)[colnames(preparing_jostD) == "JostD"]      <- "P"
#colnames(preparing_jostD)[colnames(preparing_jostD) == "Gene_name"]     <- "SNP"

preparing_jostD <- na.omit(preparing_jostD[, c("CHR","BP","P","SNP")])

pdf(paste0("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu-24.04/home/ahri2/Leucodepleted/whole-genome-sequence-analysis/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hrp2_status/pop_stat/manhattan_plot_", i, ".pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
manhattan(preparing_jostD,
          chr = "CHR",
          bp = "BP",
          p = "P",
          snp = "SNP",
          logp = FALSE,
          ylab = "Jost's D",
          main = paste0(i, " - Manhattan Plot"))
dev.off()

}
```
